references.authors: Helle L, Kull M, Mayer S, Marincola G, Zelder ME, Goerke C, Wolz C, Bertram R
references.title: Vectors for improved Tet repressor-dependent gradual gene induction in Staphylococcus aureus.

label: tetO
note: tetO: the 19 bp tet operator of the pRAB expression vectors, the TetR binding site that makes Pxyl/tet anhydrotetracycline-inducible. Sequence of record: pRAB11 (JN635500) 4135..4153, which is the downstream operator (tetO2) of the catalog's Pxyl/tet. It is not either Tn10 operator window: the Tn10 control region (J01830) carries CACTCTATCATTGATAGAG and TCCCTATCAGTGATAGAGA, which differ from this one at one and at four positions.

provenance.sequence_source: JN635500 (cloning vector pRAB11, Helle et al. 2011), 4135..4153, 100% over 19 bp
